entity: Small, non-exempt US-listed foreign private issuers, late insider Form 3 filings after the March 18, 2026 deadline
what_we_add: a third of small non-exempt foreign issuers filed 13+ days late; China/HK trail other small foreign issuers by 12 points; gap not significant against non-Israel peers (p = 0.08) or Asian/US/Australian peers (p = 0.53)
why: A&O Shearman covers the SEC's relief for late insider filings caused by missing EDGAR access, with an April 1 backstop, so the late-filing pattern was anticipated. No usable source counts who actually filed late; the SEC FAQ was blocked and isn't paywalled, so it's ignored.
